method_role.long_term_memory: clean2023 exact enzyme-reaction graph used as non-parametric recall around the frozen BRIDGE prior
method_role.episodic_memory: runtime positive relations absent from clean2023, including later database additions or user-confirmed positives
method_role.double_counting_policy: a runtime support that is already a clean2023 positive for the query is filtered from episodic memory and cannot vote a second time
method_role.candidate_universe_policy: episodic supports condition the query but do not enter or shrink the Broad candidate universe
method_role.missing_policy: missing or unencodable optional episodic supports are neutral and the already-valid BRIDGE prior remains usable

episodic_memory.representation: query-to-support attention in the frozen Broad embedding space followed by an attention-weighted support memory vector
episodic_memory.adapter: score-space equivalent of a one-step low-rank query update

gate_semantics.1: replace only the Broad query component by the episodic support-memory component

external_support.external_proteins: lazy ESM-C 600m mean encoding followed by the frozen Broad protein tower
external_support.external_reactions: current general_merged DRFP+categorial 2115-dimensional feature contract followed by the frozen Broad reaction tower

validation_training.surface: firewalled source-expansion validation relations disjoint from every frozen outer-test relation
validation_training.episode_rule: one deterministic episode per multi-positive query; support size selected deterministically from 1,2,4 and clipped to leave at least one target

frozen_outer_fewshot_diagnostic.scope: few-shot episodic-memory diagnostic only; separate from zero-shot BRIDGE headline

compatibility.no_runtime_episodic_support: same existing BRIDGE route and score-source semantics
compatibility.training_positive_passed_as_runtime_seed: ignored by episodic memory; observed Top10 identical in direct runtime smoke test
compatibility.external_protein_support_runtime_smoke: passed: fake-ID sequence encoded by existing ESM-C 600m path and frozen Broad protein tower; episodic_external_support_count=1; no external errors
compatibility.external_reaction_support_runtime_smoke: passed: fake-ID reaction encoded by current 2115-dimensional reaction feature contract and frozen Broad reaction tower; episodic_external_support_count=1; no external errors
